The '''Dagon'hai Monks''' are a boss in [[The Fractured Archive]], along with the [[Dagon'hai Elder]]. During a given raid of The Fractured Archive, players can choose to either fight the Dagon'hai Elder and the Dagon'hai Monks or fight [[Xarth]] as the fourth boss encounter.
